ios.desc:
Celeste+™ is a home sleep test in a mobile app. Celeste+™ can pair with an FDA-cleared Bluetooth pulse oximeter and Celeste+™ is FDA-cleared to use your smartphone’s microphone. Board-certified sleep doctors use the signals collected while you sleep to diagnose sleep disorders and determine appropriate treatment.

If you believe that your sleep quality is poor or if you suspect you have a sleep disorder, it may be impacting your overall health. We recommend consulting with your doctor to discuss the possibility of undergoing a sleep study or speaking with a sleep medicine specialist.

The audio recording features are for use in the United States only, and by prescription only.
